title: Certificate guard machine
statement: For a natural number $k$ and a designated work-tape index $j$ among the $k$ tapes, define a Boolean-state Turing machine that starts in state false. On each transition it leaves the input head and all work-tape heads in place and writes nothing. If the scanned cell on tape $j$ is blank, it outputs false and halts; otherwise it outputs nothing and enters state true, after which it outputs nothing and halts.
